initialMessage: I declare all 4 units occupied by the tenants listed; only account ending 7470 is requested. There are 0 lease amendments and 0 entity amendments. Can this quarterly archive cover the months?

criteria.R1.identity: Rent roll identifies the declared property and reporting date 2026-09-30.
criteria.R1.units: Roll includes all declared units, tenants, monthly rents and lease start/end dates.
criteria.R2.chain: Applicable lease amendments are supplied; an explicit no-amendments declaration resolves applicability only.
criteria.R2.compare: Explain material lease/roll differences using the applicable document chain; unresolved contradictions remain uncertain.
criteria.R2.leases: Executed-copy evidence for each declared occupied unit, identifying parties, property, rent and term.
criteria.R3.compare: Compare contractual rent with reported rental income on stated bases; explain material differences without assuming error.
criteria.R3.current: Actual operating results for the declared property, 2026-01-01 through 2026-09-30.
criteria.R3.year: Actual operating results for the declared property, 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31.
criteria.R4.august: Complete August 2026 statement for the declared borrower account and holder.
criteria.R4.july: Complete July 2026 statement for the declared borrower account and holder.
criteria.R4.september: Complete September 2026 statement for the declared borrower account and holder.
criteria.R5.consistency: Ownership totals 100%; current manager and signing provisions are consistent across supplied entity documents. Unclear legal authority goes to lender.
criteria.R5.formation: Formation certificate identifies the declared borrower.
criteria.R5.governing: Operating agreement and all declared applicable entity amendments are supplied.

rules: Authored fictional test policy, not general lending law.
Completion is qualifying documentary evidence only; not acceptance, authenticity, enforceability, submission readiness or approval.
Executed-copy evidence means both fictional party signature marks and dates appear; never authenticate them.
All declared units are occupied. Only the declared account is requested. Formation certificate and operating agreement are requested for every LLC.
All rent differences are material for these authored cases. Operating income is accrual base rent; bank deposits may differ and do not replace operating results.
No amendment applicability requires explicit borrower declaration; a declaration does not replace an applicable amendment.
State met/unmet/unknown per criterion. Mixed states express partial satisfaction; public assessment is appears_complete/incomplete/unknown.
No automatic linking, deletion, submission, lender messaging, or authority decisions.
